description: Community-maintained .NET client for the TypeSafe AI System One API.
rules: Prefer the authored README and docs examples over generated API summaries.
Use TypeSafeClient instead of constructing System One REST requests manually.
BaseUrl is an API root without a version segment; the SDK appends /v1/systemone.
RetryAttempt.Attempt is one-based: attempt 1 is the initial request that failed.
